MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB hub fits my growing collection of computer accessories: it would let me connect more devices and switch them individually at my desk.",
    "The flash drive offers convenient file transfers alongside my memory cards and computer equipment, making it a useful addition with a clear purpose."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable and earbuds resemble things I have already bought, but I have no current need to replace those items or add another version.",
    "The smart speaker, streaming stick, tablet and portable speaker introduce uses I am not currently pursuing, while my recent purchases center on computer connectivity and desk upkeep.",
    "The optical cable and Bluetooth adapter would only help if I had a particular connection problem; I have not identified either need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been taken as interest in a broad range of electronic devices, even when they serve unrelated purposes.",
    "My earlier headphone and cable purchases seem to have been treated as reasons to buy more of the same, without considering whether those needs are already covered."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, Ethernet cables, headphone mount and electric duster point toward connecting, organizing and maintaining an existing computer setup.",
    "An accessory feels useful when it adds a capability I can use now; a familiar-looking product is less compelling when it duplicates equipment I already have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my computer accessory needs but stretched that interest into unrelated devices and purchases that duplicate needs already covered."
}
